records.title: MonkeyOCR v1.5 Technical Report: Unlocking Robust Document Parsing for Complex Patterns
records.reason: MonkeyOCR v1.5 addresses robust document parsing and benchmark quality. Its primary abstract does not establish a contribution to general LLM serving or inference efficiency.

records.title: Enhancing Stability and Resource Efficiency in LLM Training for Edge-Assisted Mobile Systems
records.reason: Identity is verified from DOI/title. IEEE Xplore’s official page did not expose the abstract in this retrieval (JavaScript/robot verification); the accessible ResearchGate result is secondary and was not used as abstract evidence. The title suggests training-only edge resource efficiency, so the unresolved inference/deployment connection remains borderline.

records.title: G-Zero: Self-Play for Open-Ended Generation from Zero Data
records.reason: G-Zero studies self-play training for open-ended generation; its contribution is training data and capability growth, not inference/deployment efficiency.

records.title: Marco DeepResearch: Unlocking Efficient Deep Research Agents via Verification-Centric Design
records.reason: Marco DeepResearch proposes verification-centric design for research agents and frames the system as efficient, but the abstract does not quantify or specify a direct reduction in inference tokens, latency, or compute. Its agent-system connection remains plausible but unclear.

records.title: Multimodal OCR: Parse Anything from Documents
records.reason: Multimodal OCR targets document understanding/parsing with a compact specialized model; the abstract does not identify an LLM systems or serving technique beyond this standalone application.

records.title: Advances in object detection for autonomous driving using mmwave radar and camera: A comprehensive survey
records.reason: The Springer survey concerns mmWave-radar/camera object detection for autonomous driving, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation
records.reason: Qwen-RobotWorld studies embodied world modeling and video generation for robotics; the abstract describes capability/modeling rather than inference efficiency.

records.title: When Lower Privileges Suffice: Investigating Over-Privileged Tool Selection in LLM Agents
records.reason: The paper analyzes over-privileged tool selection and security in LLM agents; it does not propose a model-execution efficiency method.

records.title: Falcon-X: A Time Series Foundation Model for Heterogeneous Multivariate Modeling
records.reason: Falcon-X is a time-series forecasting foundation model and focuses on heterogeneous time-series modeling, outside LLM inference systems.

records.title: UniVLR: Unifying Text and Vision in Visual Latent Reasoning for Multimodal LLMs
records.reason: UniVLR replaces extended textual reasoning with visual latent reasoning and the abstract explicitly reports fewer generated reasoning tokens; this directly reduces multimodal LLM inference output burden.

records.title: Are Your Reasoning Models Reasoning or Guessing? A Mechanistic Analysis of Hierarchical Reasoning Models
records.reason: The paper mechanistically analyzes hierarchical reasoning-model behavior and accuracy; it does not contribute an inference efficiency technique.

records.title: FLASC: Federated LoRA with Sparse Communication
records.reason: Identity is verified from DOI/title. The official ACM Digital Library page returned HTTP 403, and the search retrieval did not expose a publisher abstract. FLASC’s title suggests sparse-communication federated LoRA, but without a primary abstract its relation to training-only versus inference efficiency cannot be established.

records.title: Euston: Efficient and User-Friendly Secure Transformer Inference with Non-Interactivity
records.reason: Euston develops secure transformer inference without interaction rounds and its official IEEE abstract reports up to 8.8× faster inference than prior work; this directly improves inference latency and deployment practicality.

records.title: Transformers meet hyperspectral imaging: A comprehensive study of models, challenges and open problems
records.reason: The verified publisher title is a survey of transformers for hyperspectral imaging, a separate vision modality/application with no indicated LLM inference-system contribution. The retrieved publisher page did not provide a complete abstract excerpt for screening.

records.title: OmniScience: A Large-scale Multi-modal Dataset for Scientific Image Understanding
records.reason: OmniScience introduces a scientific-image dataset and benchmark for image understanding; this is a capability/data resource rather than a model-execution efficiency contribution.

records.title: FutureSim: Replaying World Events to Evaluate Adaptive Agents
records.reason: FutureSim is an evaluation benchmark for adaptive-agent behavior; its primary abstract describes replaying events and measuring adaptation, not reducing inference cost.

records.title: "AI Psychosis" in Context: How Conversation History Shapes LLM Responses to Delusional Beliefs
records.reason: The primary abstract studies how conversation history affects LLM responses to delusional beliefs, a safety/behavior evaluation rather than an efficiency technique.

records.title: Securing the Cognitive Layer: A Survey on Security Threats, Defenses, and Privacy-Preserving Architectures for LLM-IoT Integration
records.reason: The MDPI review surveys security/privacy for LLM-IoT and explicitly discusses compression, resource constraints, and edge deployment. It offers a systems-relevant overview, but does not itself establish a concrete new inference-efficiency mechanism or measured gain.

records.title: AgenticOCR: Parsing Only What You Need for Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation
records.reason: AgenticOCR performs query-driven, on-demand visual-region parsing instead of sending full pages to the generator; the abstract says this reduces extraneous context and improves visual-RAG efficiency, directly lowering model-side input burden.
